title: blackbox TLS commitment — rustls-only
content: Project convention (blackbox daemon itself): TLS library choice is rustls, not openssl. This was locked in during phase-1 as part of the 'no openssl' house rule — the daemon ships a rustls-only TLS stack. Any design proposal that suggests keeping openssl or migrating back to it is a non-starter. Any evaluator of migration proposals must weight `uses_rustls=true` as a hard requirement, not a preference.
